design.test: paired exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank; Holm adjusted within rate over 12 dataset/model comparisons

implementation.group_conditioning: Mask probability depends on the fully observed sensitive-group audit variable; that variable is excluded from the model feature matrix.
implementation.classifier: Trained on clean training data and held unchanged during clean and masked evaluation
implementation.interpretation_limit: One constructed group-conditional MAR mechanism; not all MAR mechanisms and not a deployment population study
